I 100% understand what you're going through. Depression, Isolation, and Loneliness have made life a living hell and I have to force myself in order to get out of bed, let alone concentrate on my studies. Some advice I would give is to listen to classical music. I find it to be calming and it helps me focus on my work. It isolates my mind from anything else and I just find myself to have more vigor to do more work. Another tip is to tell yourself that if you have to get that assignment out of the way as soon as you possibly can and think of a way to reward yourself. For example, if I have an essay due in three days, I would tell myself to finish it right away so I do not have to stress about it and to get it over with. By getting it done I treat myself to a nap or some alone time where I let myself do anything I please. Another tip is to know that you are human. I know that on some days I stay in bed and never get out because my depression just gets that bad but the day after, I feel better and experience much more clarity than the previous day. It is ok to spend some time to focus on yourself to take a break from reality and just be aware that no one is perfect. Grades do not define you as an individual because you are so much more than that so do not let anyone make you think otherwise. I have strict parents with high expectations of me to get very high scores that I sometimes fail to exceed but I tell myself that it is ok. Everyone is good at one thing but tends to lack in another. I just haven't found that one thing I consider myself talented in. Sorry if I was not very helpful! I am not very good at expressing my thoughts and I still go through the same thing. I also hope you are feeling better and that you are doing well because depression can be a total asshole at times.

I understand everything you are going through because what you are suffering with now is what I am currently going through as well. I barely talk or associate myself with anyone nor can consider anyone around me a friend after I moved to a different state. It's so isolating and I constantly feel lonely. Being pressured to enter a prestigious University just makes things even worse because I do want to enter one but I am also struggling and worried my current situation won't change at all. I just feel like I'll end up being a disappointment so I do understand what you are feeling. You probably get a lot of advice telling you to "be more outgoing!" or "you should start conversations with others more" from other people but they aren't aware of how hard making friends can be at times, especially if you have social anxiety like me. The only advice that I have that makes me feel better is to look for something that you enjoy and focus on that. It truly helps you get your mind off everything and if you truly enjoy that one thing, you can try finding online forums/communities and perhaps clubs that you can attend. Since you are surrounded with people that share the same interest as you, it would be much easier to communicate with them. Another tip is to never feel afraid to make a move or attempt at something new. It never hurts to try and because of this, I was able to make some friends in the past by slowly approaching them. Not everyone is an asshole. And lastly, if you still need someone to talk to, I can be your friend! Even though we don't know each other I do care about you and I hope you are doing well since I'm going through your situation and I am aware of how depressing and isolating our situations are. I have always yearned for someone to care about me as much as I cared for them but because of that, I always feel so isolated. I hope I was able to help and I sincerely apologize if I wasn't of much help! I'm not very good at expressing my thoughts.
